name: Custom Islands
author: FranzFischer78 + MegaMatrixs
description: Build your own islands in an in-game editor and find them while sailing! Sculpt and paint terrain with Raft's own ground textures, place trees, rocks, corals and props from Raft's islands, and save your islands. In your worlds they appear on their own as you sail (or spawn one with SpawnIsland): walk on them, run aground on them, chop palms and pick berries. Works in multiplayer: players who join get the host's islands automatically.
